text:
deploy-bot: preflight green, starting v2 progressive roll at 14:05 UTC. ramp plan: 2% -> 8% -> 20% over 30m. features: header normalization + streaming reassembler + embeddings/v2 schema change. pinlists in effect: tenant-exclude.csv
andrea: quick note — embeddings clients may POST with legacy payload key 'vectors' vs new 'embeddings'. preflight flagged 0.1% schema-mismatch errors in staging for tenant 'marlin'
cam: staging repro: marlin saw truncated streams when context >6k tokens and embedding calls sometimes 400 due to key mismatch.
ops-maya: monitor rule triggered: marlin slice 4 5xx spike to 0.85% at 14:09 UTC (3m). auto-pause threshold is 0.8% over 4m per runbook.
deploy-bot: auto-paused slice 4 at 14:10 UTC. traffic for that slice reverted to v1.
leo: can we apply a temporary pin for marlin and clio? they're on the same proxy path.
ops-maya: pin command (ops token required):
```
curl -s -X POST https://deploy.internal/pin \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"tenant":"marlin","route":"/api","version":"v1","reason":"v2 stream+embeddings regressions","expires":"2026-04-05T00:00:00Z"}'
```
andea: typo in command above — that's andrea :)
andrea: pin applied via UI and API; deploy-bot acknowledged in 18s. telemetry backfill shows marlin 5xx down to 0.02% after 2m.
cam: SDK teams — can we do a targeted hotfix? prefer not to revert header normalization globally. patch idea: 1) accept legacy 'vectors' key when Content-Type is application/json, 2) tighten stream boundary reassembler for long contexts.
product-jem: product ok with narrow hotfix canary for long-context tenants after patch bake. require CS notification and release note blurb.
leo: release notes checklist: add compatibility section, pin instructions, sample curl, and rollback criteria: if >5% of canary capacity is pinned OR any tenant >1% 5xx for 6m -> schedule full rollback and page oncall.
ops-maya: incident INC-2026-621 opened. assigning to oncall and adding postmortem placeholder.
deploy-bot: monitoring update: slices resumed where safe; pinned tenants excluded from v2. overall canary health stable.
cam: hotfix PR created, CI running. will request narrow canary to re-run marlin+clio after green.
andrea: I'll update release notes and draft tenant outreach email. add FAQ: how to pin, expected SDK versions, and 'why this happened' short explanation.
product-jem: please include steps for customers to test against a staging v2 endpoint and contact CS.
leo: ok, keep me posted. if hotfix bake fails we'll do rollback window at next operator meeting.
ops-maya: monitoring watch set for 90m. paging thresholds in place.
cam: thanks team — keeping this thread for rollout coordination and release notes edits.
